trello_card.description:
## Savvy Games Group - VC Outreach Packet

### Fund Overview
- **Fund Name:** Savvy Games Group (SGG)
- **Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (global operations, LA office)
- **AUM:** $37.8 billion committed investment from PIF (Public Investment Fund)
- **Stage Focus:** All stages - from seed to mega-acquisitions
- **Check Size:** $1M to $10B+ (has done $1B+ deals)

### Investment Thesis
Savvy is the National Champion for Games and Esports in Saudi Arabia, wholly owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF). Their mission:
- Build a robust games ecosystem in Saudi Arabia
- Transform the nation into a global games and esports hub by 2030
- Drive innovation, growth, and value creation across the global gaming ecosystem

**Strategic Goals (2030 Vision):**
- Set up 250 games companies in Saudi Arabia
- Create 39,000 jobs in the gaming sector
- Raise sector contribution to Saudi GDP to 50 billion riyals (~$13.3B)

**AI/Gaming Infrastructure Alignment:** VERY HIGH
- Acquired Scopely ($4.9B) - leading mobile game platform with AI/ML capabilities
- Acquired ESL FACEIT (EFG) - esports infrastructure leader
- Building Steer Studios (Riyadh-based AAA studio)
- Actively seeking technology that enables game development and esports

### Key Partner: Brian Ward
- **Title:** Chief Executive Officer (Founding CEO)
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/brianward/
- **Email:** brian.ward@savvygames.com (inferred)
- **Background:** 30 years leadership experience at Electronic Arts; former head of worldwide studios at EA
- **Achievement:** Led Savvy to become world's largest esports company and top games publisher in 3 years

**Secondary Contacts:**
- Investment team accessible through website contact form
- Business development team at Savvy

### Major Acquisitions & Investments
- **Scopely** - $4.9B acquisition (2023) - Mobile game publisher (MONOPOLY GO!, Stumble Guys)
- **Embracer Group** - $1B investment (2022)
- **ESL FACEIT Group (EFG)** - Full acquisition - Esports World Cup operator
- **Steer Studios** - Internal AAA studio being built in Riyadh
- **Nine66** - Ecosystem builder for Saudi game development

### Recent Activity
- January 2026: 4-year anniversary, reflecting on major growth
- Active partnership with Al Hilal Saudi Football Club
- Expanding LA operations through Scopely
- Heavy focus on building Saudi gaming ecosystem

### Outreach Angle
**Primary Hook:** Gaming infrastructure that enables global game development - Savvy is building the Saudi gaming ecosystem from scratch and needs technology partners. Position as infrastructure that helps them achieve their 250-company, 39,000-job vision.

**Secondary Hooks:**
1. Scopely connection - they own a major platform now
2. EFG/esports infrastructure angle
3. Technology transfer/value creation for Saudi ecosystem
4. Global expansion with Saudi backing

### Outreach Strategy
1. Lead with ecosystem enablement - how we help build the Saudi gaming economy
2. Reference Scopely acquisition and platform strategy
3. Emphasize technology/infrastructure (not content creation)
4. Position as strategic partner for ecosystem development

### Key Considerations
- **Geopolitical Factor:** Saudi PIF backing means substantial capital but also geopolitical considerations
- **Long-term Vision:** They think in 10+ year horizons (Vision 2030)
- **Ecosystem Play:** They want to build, not just invest - infrastructure plays are highly valued
- **Scale:** They can write massive checks - enterprise deals preferred

### Resources
- Website: https://www.savvygames.com
- About: https://www.savvygames.com/about
- PIF Portfolio: https://www.pif.gov.sa/en/our-investments/our-portfolio/savvy-games-group/
